title: Speed Puzzling at Starr Hill
venue: Starr Hill Beer Hall & Rooftop — Scott’s Addition
description: Race to complete a 500-piece puzzle in 90 minutes. Bring a team of up to 4, or sign up solo and we’ll match you up. Winners get prizes, and every team keeps their puzzle.

access.notes: The organizer confirms wheelchair access to the venue and the puzzle event. Contact us in writing about any specific seating or access needs.
